#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Shared resolver for the native and WASM Callisto setup actions.  This file
# deliberately contains the closed product-release vocabulary; it never reads
# a checkout manifest to decide what product or target to install.

set -euo pipefail

CALLISTO_REPOSITORY="orin-dx/callisto"
CALLISTO_RELEASES_URL="https://github.com/${CALLISTO_REPOSITORY}/releases/download"
CALLISTO_LATEST_API="https://api.github.com/repos/${CALLISTO_REPOSITORY}/releases/latest"

callisto_error() {
  printf '::error::setup-callisto: %s\n' "$*" >&2
  return 1
}

callisto_parse_version() {
  local requested="$1"
  case "$requested" in
    latest)
      CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND="latest"
      CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION=""
      ;;
    callisto@*)
      CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND="exact"
      CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION="${requested#callisto@}"
      ;;
    *)
      CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND="exact"
      CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION="$requested"
      ;;
  esac

  if [[ "$CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND" == "exact" \
    && ! "$CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    callisto_error "version '$requested' must be latest, X.Y.Z, or callisto@X.Y.Z"
    return 1
  fi
}

callisto_resolve_latest() {
  local tag
  if [[ -n "${CALLISTO_LATEST_TAG:-}" ]]; then
    tag="$CALLISTO_LATEST_TAG"
  else
    tag="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location "$CALLISTO_LATEST_API" | jq -er '.tag_name')" \
      || callisto_error "could not resolve latest Callisto product release"
  fi

  case "$tag" in
    callisto@*) CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION="${tag#callisto@}" ;;
    *)
      callisto_error "latest release tag '$tag' is not a callisto@X.Y.Z product release"
      return 1
      ;;
  esac
  if ! [[ "$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    callisto_error "latest release tag '$tag' does not contain a semantic version"
    return 1
  fi
}

callisto_select_target() {
  local artifact="$1"
  if [[ "$artifact" == "wasm" ]]; then
    CALLISTO_TARGET="wasm32-wasip1"
    CALLISTO_ASSET_NAME="callisto-moon-wasm32-wasip1.wasm"
    return 0
  fi

  local os_name arch_name
  os_name="${CALLISTO_TEST_OS:-$(uname -s)}"
  arch_name="${CALLISTO_TEST_ARCH:-$(uname -m)}"
  os_name="$(printf '%s' "$os_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
  case "${os_name}:${arch_name}" in
    darwin:arm64|darwin:aarch64)
      CALLISTO_TARGET="aarch64-apple-darwin"
      ;;
    linux:x86_64)
      CALLISTO_TARGET="x86_64-unknown-linux-musl"
      ;;
    linux:arm64|linux:aarch64)
      CALLISTO_TARGET="aarch64-unknown-linux-musl"
      ;;
    *)
      callisto_error "unsupported host ${os_name}/${arch_name}; supported native targets are aarch64-apple-darwin, x86_64-unknown-linux-musl, and aarch64-unknown-linux-musl"
      return 1
      ;;
  esac
  CALLISTO_ASSET_NAME="callisto-${CALLISTO_TARGET}.tar.gz"
}

# Resolve one immutable product release before source selection or cache use.
# Sets globals consumed by the composite actions and emits no network effects
# for exact input versions.
callisto_resolve() {
  local source="$1" version="$2" artifact="$3"
  case "$source" in auto|release|registry|local) ;; *)
    callisto_error "source '$source' must be auto, release, registry, or local"
    return 1
  esac
  callisto_parse_version "$version" || return 1
  if [[ "$source" == "local" && "$CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND" == "exact" ]]; then
    callisto_error "source=local only accepts version=latest; it cannot build an exact released version"
    return 1
  fi

  if [[ "$source" == "local" ]]; then
    CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION="local"
    CALLISTO_RELEASE_TAG=""
    CALLISTO_REGISTRY_VERSION=""
  elif [[ "$CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND" == "latest" ]]; then
    callisto_resolve_latest || return 1
    CALLISTO_RELEASE_TAG="callisto@${CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION}"
    CALLISTO_REGISTRY_VERSION="$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION"
  else
    CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION="$CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION"
    CALLISTO_RELEASE_TAG="callisto@${CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION}"
    CALLISTO_REGISTRY_VERSION="$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION"
  fi

  CALLISTO_SOURCE="$source"
  callisto_select_target "$artifact" || return 1
  printf 'Resolved Callisto version: %s (target: %s)\n' "$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION" "$CALLISTO_TARGET"
}

callisto_write_outputs() {
  : "${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?GITHUB_OUTPUT must be set before writing resolver outputs}"
  {
    printf 'resolved-version=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION"
    printf 'release-tag=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_RELEASE_TAG"
    printf 'registry-version=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_REGISTRY_VERSION"
    printf 'source=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_SOURCE"
    printf 'target=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_TARGET"
    printf 'asset-name=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_ASSET_NAME"
  } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
}

callisto_require_local_workspace() {
  local workspace="$1"
  [[ -f "$workspace/Cargo.toml" ]] \
    && rg -q '^name = "callisto-cli"' "$workspace/crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml" \
    || callisto_error "source=local requires a Callisto workspace checkout"
}

callisto_install_native() {
  local source="$1" version="$2" tag="$3" asset="$4" bin_dir="$5" workspace="$6"
  mkdir -p "$bin_dir"
  case "$source" in
    local)
      callisto_require_local_workspace "$workspace"
      local commit built_version
      commit="$(git -C "$workspace" rev-parse HEAD)" || callisto_error "source=local checkout has no readable commit"
      cargo build --manifest-path "$workspace/Cargo.toml" -p callisto-cli
      cp "$workspace/target/debug/callisto" "$bin_dir/callisto"
      built_version="$($bin_dir/callisto --version)" || callisto_error "locally built Callisto did not run"
      printf 'Built Callisto from checkout commit %s: %s\n' "$commit" "$built_version"
      ;;
    registry)
      cargo install callisto-cli --version "$version" --locked --root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install" --quiet
      cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto" "$bin_dir/callisto"
      ;;
    release|auto)
      # S-003 supplies the fail-closed 404-only auto fallback classification.
      curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
        "${CALLISTO_RELEASES_URL}/${tag}/${asset}" \
        --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/${asset}"
      tar -xzf "${RUNNER_TEMP}/${asset}" -C "$bin_dir"
      ;;
    *) callisto_error "internal error: unsupported source '$source'" ;;
  esac
}

callisto_install_wasm() {
  local source="$1" tag="$2" asset="$3" destination="$4" workspace="$5"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$destination")"
  case "$source" in
    local)
      callisto_require_local_workspace "$workspace"
      cargo build --manifest-path "$workspace/Cargo.toml" -p callisto-moon --target wasm32-wasip1 --features pdk --release
      cp "$workspace/target/wasm32-wasip1/release/callisto_moon.wasm" "$destination"
      ;;
    release|auto)
      curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
        "${CALLISTO_RELEASES_URL}/${tag}/${asset}" --output "$destination"
      ;;
    registry)
      callisto_error "source=registry does not provide the callisto-moon WASM artifact"
      ;;
    *) callisto_error "internal error: unsupported source '$source'" ;;
  esac
}

    tag="$CALLISTO_LATEST_TAG"
  else
    tag="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location "$CALLISTO_LATEST_API" | jq -er '.tag_name')" \
      || callisto_error "could not resolve latest Callisto product release"
  fi

  case "$tag" in
    callisto@*) CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION="${tag#callisto@}" ;;
    *)
      callisto_error "latest release tag '$tag' is not a callisto@X.Y.Z product release"
      return 1
      ;;
  esac
  if ! [[ "$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    callisto_error "latest release tag '$tag' does not contain a semantic version"
    return 1
  fi
}

callisto_select_target() {
  local artifact="$1"
  if [[ "$artifact" == "wasm" ]]; then
    CALLISTO_TARGET="wasm32-wasip1"
    CALLISTO_ASSET_NAME="callisto-moon-wasm32-wasip1.wasm"
    return 0
  fi

  local os_name arch_name
  os_name="${CALLISTO_TEST_OS:-$(uname -s)}"
  arch_name="${CALLISTO_TEST_ARCH:-$(uname -m)}"
  os_name="$(printf '%s' "$os_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
  case "${os_name}:${arch_name}" in
    darwin:arm64|darwin:aarch64)
      CALLISTO_TARGET="aarch64-apple-darwin"
      ;;
    linux:x86_64)
      CALLISTO_TARGET="x86_64-unknown-linux-musl"
      ;;
    linux:arm64|linux:aarch64)
      CALLISTO_TARGET="aarch64-unknown-linux-musl"
      ;;
    *)
      callisto_error "unsupported host ${os_name}/${arch_name}; supported native targets are aarch64-apple-darwin, x86_64-unknown-linux-musl, and aarch64-unknown-linux-musl"
      return 1
      ;;
  esac
  CALLISTO_ASSET_NAME="callisto-${CALLISTO_TARGET}.tar.gz"
}

# Resolve one immutable product release before source selection or cache use.
# Sets globals consumed by the composite actions and emits no network effects
# for exact input versions.
callisto_resolve() {
  local source="$1" version="$2" artifact="$3"
  case "$source" in auto|release|registry|local) ;; *)
    callisto_error "source '$source' must be auto, release, registry, or local"
    return 1
  esac
  callisto_parse_version "$version" || return 1
  if [[ "$source" == "local" && "$CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND" == "exact" ]]; then
    callisto_error "source=local only accepts version=latest; it cannot build an exact released version"
    return 1
  fi

  if [[ "$source" == "local" ]]; then
    CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION="local"
    CALLISTO_RELEASE_TAG=""
    CALLISTO_REGISTRY_VERSION=""
  elif [[ "$CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND" == "latest" ]]; then
    callisto_resolve_latest || return 1
    CALLISTO_RELEASE_TAG="callisto@${CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION}"
    CALLISTO_REGISTRY_VERSION="$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION"
  else
    CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION="$CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION"
    CALLISTO_RELEASE_TAG="callisto@${CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION}"
    CALLISTO_REGISTRY_VERSION="$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION"
  fi

  CALLISTO_SOURCE="$source"
  callisto_select_target "$artifact" || return 1
  printf 'Resolved Callisto version: %s (target: %s)\n' "$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION" "$CALLISTO_TARGET"
}

callisto_write_outputs() {
  : "${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?GITHUB_OUTPUT must be set before writing resolver outputs}"
  {
    printf 'resolved-version=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION"
    printf 'release-tag=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_RELEASE_TAG"
    printf 'registry-version=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_REGISTRY_VERSION"
    printf 'source=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_SOURCE"
    printf 'target=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_TARGET"
    printf 'asset-name=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_ASSET_NAME"
  } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
}

callisto_require_local_workspace() {
  local workspace="$1"
  [[ -f "$workspace/Cargo.toml" ]] \
    && rg -q '^name = "callisto-cli"' "$workspace/crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml" \
    || callisto_error "source=local requires a Callisto workspace checkout"
}

callisto_install_native() {
  local source="$1" version="$2" tag="$3" asset="$4" bin_dir="$5" workspace="$6"
  mkdir -p "$bin_dir"
  case "$source" in
    local)
      callisto_require_local_workspace "$workspace"
      local commit built_version
      commit="$(git -C "$workspace" rev-parse HEAD)" || callisto_error "source=local checkout has no readable commit"
      cargo build --manifest-path "$workspace/Cargo.toml" -p callisto-cli
      cp "$workspace/target/debug/callisto" "$bin_dir/callisto"
      built_version="$($bin_dir/callisto --version)" || callisto_error "locally built Callisto did not run"
      printf 'Built Callisto from checkout commit %s: %s\n' "$commit" "$built_version"
      ;;
    registry)
      cargo install callisto-cli --version "$version" --locked --root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install" --quiet
      cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto" "$bin_dir/callisto"
      ;;
    release|auto)
      # S-003 supplies the fail-closed 404-only auto fallback classification.
      curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
        "${CALLISTO_RELEASES_URL}/${tag}/${asset}" \
        --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/${asset}"
      tar -xzf "${RUNNER_TEMP}/${asset}" -C "$bin_dir"
      ;;
    *) callisto_error "internal error: unsupported source '$source'" ;;
  esac
}

callisto_install_wasm() {
  local source="$1" tag="$2" asset="$3" destination="$4" workspace="$5"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$destination")"
  case "$source" in
    local)
      callisto_require_local_workspace "$workspace"
      cargo build --manifest-path "$workspace/Cargo.toml" -p callisto-moon --target wasm32-wasip1 --features pdk --release
      cp "$workspace/target/wasm32-wasip1/release/callisto_moon.wasm" "$destination"
      ;;
    release|auto)
      curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
        "${CALLISTO_RELEASES_URL}/${tag}/${asset}" --output "$destination"
      ;;
    registry)
      callisto_error "source=registry does not provide the callisto-moon WASM artifact"
      ;;
    *) callisto_error "internal error: unsupported source '$source'" ;;
  esac
}
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Table-driven, no-network contract tests for the shared setup-action resolver.
set -u

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
# shellcheck source=../lib/setup-callisto.sh
source "$ROOT/lib/setup-callisto.sh"

fail=0

expect_resolve() {
  local name="$1" source_name="$2" version="$3" artifact="$4" os_name="$5" arch_name="$6" expected="$7"
  local output code
  output="$(CALLISTO_TEST_OS="$os_name" CALLISTO_TEST_ARCH="$arch_name" CALLISTO_LATEST_TAG="callisto@9.8.7" \
    callisto_resolve "$source_name" "$version" "$artifact" 2>&1)"
  code=$?
  if [[ $code -ne 0 || "$output" != *"$expected"* ]]; then
    printf 'FAIL %s: code=%s output=%s\n' "$name" "$code" "$output"
    fail=1
  else
    printf 'PASS %s\n' "$name"
  fi
}

expect_reject() {
  local name="$1" source_name="$2" version="$3" artifact="$4" os_name="$5" arch_name="$6" expected="$7"
  local output code
  set +e
  output="$(CALLISTO_TEST_OS="$os_name" CALLISTO_TEST_ARCH="$arch_name" CALLISTO_LATEST_TAG="callisto@9.8.7" \
    callisto_resolve "$source_name" "$version" "$artifact" 2>&1)"
  code=$?
  set -e
  if [[ $code -eq 0 || "$output" != *"$expected"* ]]; then
    printf 'FAIL %s: code=%s output=%s\n' "$name" "$code" "$output"
    fail=1
  else
    printf 'PASS %s\n' "$name"
  fi
}

# Every source mode and both exact spellings resolve to the same semantic
# version; latest is pinned by one injected release lookup before target use.
expect_resolve auto_exact auto 1.2.3 native Linux x86_64 'Resolved Callisto version: 1.2.3'
expect_resolve release_product_tag release callisto@1.2.3 native Linux x86_64 'Resolved Callisto version: 1.2.3'
expect_resolve registry_exact registry 1.2.3 native Linux x86_64 'Resolved Callisto version: 1.2.3'
expect_resolve local_latest local latest native Linux x86_64 'Resolved Callisto version: local'
expect_resolve latest_pinned auto latest native Linux x86_64 'Resolved Callisto version: 9.8.7'

# The resolver exposes a single immutable latest result to action cache keys.
outputs_file="$(mktemp)"
GITHUB_OUTPUT="$outputs_file"
CALLISTO_TEST_OS=Linux
CALLISTO_TEST_ARCH=x86_64
CALLISTO_LATEST_TAG=callisto@9.8.7
callisto_resolve auto latest wasm >/dev/null
GITHUB_OUTPUT="$outputs_file" callisto_write_outputs
if ! rg -Fx 'resolved-version=9.8.7' "$outputs_file" >/dev/null \
  || ! rg -Fx 'target=wasm32-wasip1' "$outputs_file" >/dev/null; then
  printf 'FAIL latest_writes_immutable_output\n'
  fail=1
else
  printf 'PASS latest_writes_immutable_output\n'
fi
rm -f "$outputs_file"

# Native product target mapping is closed, while the WASM target is independent
# of the host running the resolver.
expect_resolve macos_arm64 auto 1.2.3 native Darwin arm64 'aarch64-apple-darwin'
expect_resolve linux_x86_64 auto 1.2.3 native Linux x86_64 'x86_64-unknown-linux-musl'
expect_resolve linux_aarch64 auto 1.2.3 native Linux aarch64 'aarch64-unknown-linux-musl'
expect_resolve wasm_target auto 1.2.3 wasm SunOS sun4u 'wasm32-wasip1'

expect_reject bad_source git 1.2.3 native Linux x86_64 'must be auto, release, registry, or local'
expect_reject bad_version auto callisto-cli@1.2.3 native Linux x86_64 'must be latest, X.Y.Z, or callisto@X.Y.Z'
expect_reject local_exact local 1.2.3 native Linux x86_64 'source=local only accepts version=latest'
expect_reject macos_x86_64 auto 1.2.3 native Darwin x86_64 'unsupported host darwin/x86_64'
expect_reject linux_i686 auto 1.2.3 native Linux i686 'unsupported host linux/i686'
expect_reject windows auto 1.2.3 native Windows_NT x86_64 'unsupported host windows_nt/x86_64'

# Command stubs prove the registry branch is version-pinned and no resolver or
# installer branch can reach an unpinned cargo --git install.
calls_file="$(mktemp)"
stub_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
mkdir -p "$stub_dir/bin" "$stub_dir/workspace"
printf '#!/usr/bin/env bash\nprintf "cargo %%s\\n" "$*" >> %q\nmkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin"\ntouch "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto"\n' "$calls_file" > "$stub_dir/cargo"
chmod +x "$stub_dir/cargo"
PATH="$stub_dir:$PATH" RUNNER_TEMP="$stub_dir" \
  callisto_install_native registry 1.2.3 callisto@1.2.3 ignored "$stub_dir/bin" "$stub_dir/workspace"
if ! rg -F 'cargo install callisto-cli --version 1.2.3 --locked' "$calls_file" >/dev/null \
  || rg -F -- '--git' "$calls_file" >/dev/null \
  || rg -n -- 'cargo install --git' "$ROOT/../setup-callisto-wasm/action.yml" "$ROOT/action.yml" "$ROOT/lib/setup-callisto.sh" >/dev/null; then
  printf 'FAIL pinned_registry_install_without_git_fallback\n'
  fail=1
else
  printf 'PASS pinned_registry_install_without_git_fallback\n'
fi
rm -rf "$stub_dir" "$calls_file"

exit "$fail"
name: 'Setup Callisto WASM'
description: 'Downloads and caches an immutable callisto-moon.wasm product release'
inputs:
  source:
    description: 'Where to obtain Callisto: auto, release, registry, or local.'
    required: false
    default: 'auto'
  version:
    description: 'Callisto version: latest, X.Y.Z, or callisto@X.Y.Z.'
    required: false
    default: 'latest'
  dest:
    description: 'Destination path for callisto-moon.wasm'
    required: false
    default: '.moon/cache/ext/callisto-moon.wasm'

outputs:
  path:
    description: 'Path to the local cached callisto-moon.wasm file'
    value: ${{ steps.resolve-callisto.outputs.destination }}

runs:
  using: 'composite'
  steps:
    - name: Resolve immutable Callisto release
      id: resolve-callisto
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        INPUT_WASM_DEST: ${{ inputs.dest }}
      run: |
        source "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/../setup-callisto/lib/setup-callisto.sh"
        callisto_resolve "$INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE" "$INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION" wasm
        callisto_write_outputs
        echo "destination=$INPUT_WASM_DEST" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

    - name: Cache Callisto WASM
      id: cache-wasm
      # actions/cache v4.2.3
      uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684
      with:
        path: ${{ steps.resolve-callisto.outputs.destination }}
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-callisto-wasm-${{ steps.resolve-callisto.outputs.resolved-version }}

    - name: Download Callisto WASM Plugin
      id: download-wasm
      if: steps.cache-wasm.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
      shell: bash
      env:
        RESOLVED_DEST: ${{ steps.resolve-callisto.outputs.destination }}
        RESOLVED_SOURCE: ${{ steps.resolve-callisto.outputs.source }}
        RESOLVED_TAG: ${{ steps.resolve-callisto.outputs.release-tag }}
        RESOLVED_ASSET: ${{ steps.resolve-callisto.outputs.asset-name }}
      run: |
        source "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/../setup-callisto/lib/setup-callisto.sh"
        callisto_install_wasm "$RESOLVED_SOURCE" "$RESOLVED_TAG" "$RESOLVED_ASSET" "$RESOLVED_DEST" "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
        echo "path=$RESOLVED_DEST" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# Shared resolver for the native and WASM Callisto setup actions.  This file
     3	# deliberately contains the closed product-release vocabulary; it never reads
     4	# a checkout manifest to decide what product or target to install.
     5	
     6	set -euo pipefail
     7	
     8	CALLISTO_REPOSITORY="orin-dx/callisto"
     9	CALLISTO_RELEASES_URL="https://github.com/${CALLISTO_REPOSITORY}/releases/download"
    10	CALLISTO_LATEST_API="https://api.github.com/repos/${CALLISTO_REPOSITORY}/releases/latest"
    11	
    12	callisto_error() {
    13	  printf '::error::setup-callisto: %s\n' "$*" >&2
    14	  return 1
    15	}
    16	
    17	callisto_parse_version() {
    18	  local requested="$1"
    19	  case "$requested" in
    20	    latest)
    21	      CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND="latest"
    22	      CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION=""
    23	      ;;
    24	    callisto@*)
    25	      CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND="exact"
    26	      CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION="${requested#callisto@}"
    27	      ;;
    28	    *)
    29	      CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND="exact"
    30	      CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION="$requested"
    31	      ;;
    32	  esac
    33	
    34	  if [[ "$CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND" == "exact" \
    35	    && ! "$CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    36	    callisto_error "version '$requested' must be latest, X.Y.Z, or callisto@X.Y.Z"
    37	    return 1
    38	  fi
    39	}
    40	
    41	callisto_resolve_latest() {
    42	  local tag
    43	  if [[ -n "${CALLISTO_LATEST_TAG:-}" ]]; then
    44	    tag="$CALLISTO_LATEST_TAG"
    45	  else
    46	    tag="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location "$CALLISTO_LATEST_API" | jq -er '.tag_name')" \
    47	      || {
    48	        callisto_error "could not resolve latest Callisto product release"
    49	        return 1
    50	      }
    51	  fi
    52	
    53	  case "$tag" in
    54	    callisto@*) CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION="${tag#callisto@}" ;;
    55	    *)
    56	      callisto_error "latest release tag '$tag' is not a callisto@X.Y.Z product release"
    57	      return 1
    58	      ;;
    59	  esac
    60	  if ! [[ "$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    61	    callisto_error "latest release tag '$tag' does not contain a semantic version"
    62	    return 1
    63	  fi
    64	}
    65	
    66	callisto_select_target() {
    67	  local artifact="$1"
    68	  if [[ "$artifact" == "wasm" ]]; then
    69	    CALLISTO_TARGET="wasm32-wasip1"
    70	    CALLISTO_ASSET_NAME="callisto-moon-wasm32-wasip1.wasm"
    71	    return 0
    72	  fi
    73	
    74	  local os_name arch_name
    75	  os_name="${CALLISTO_TEST_OS:-$(uname -s)}"
    76	  arch_name="${CALLISTO_TEST_ARCH:-$(uname -m)}"
    77	  os_name="$(printf '%s' "$os_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
    78	  case "${os_name}:${arch_name}" in
    79	    darwin:arm64|darwin:aarch64)
    80	      CALLISTO_TARGET="aarch64-apple-darwin"
    81	      ;;
    82	    linux:x86_64)
    83	      CALLISTO_TARGET="x86_64-unknown-linux-musl"
    84	      ;;
    85	    linux:arm64|linux:aarch64)
    86	      CALLISTO_TARGET="aarch64-unknown-linux-musl"
    87	      ;;
    88	    *)
    89	      callisto_error "unsupported host ${os_name}/${arch_name}; supported native targets are aarch64-apple-darwin, x86_64-unknown-linux-musl, and aarch64-unknown-linux-musl"
    90	      return 1
    91	      ;;
    92	  esac
    93	  CALLISTO_ASSET_NAME="callisto-${CALLISTO_TARGET}.tar.gz"
    94	}

    17	callisto_parse_version() {

    18	  local requested="$1"

    21	      CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND="latest"
    22	      CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION=""
    23	      ;;
    24	    callisto@*)
    25	      CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND="exact"
    26	      CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION="${requested#callisto@}"
    27	      ;;
    28	    *)
    29	      CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND="exact"
    30	      CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION="$requested"
    31	      ;;
    32	  esac
    33	
    34	  if [[ "$CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND" == "exact" \
    35	    && ! "$CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    36	    callisto_error "version '$requested' must be latest, X.Y.Z, or callisto@X.Y.Z"

    39	}

    41	callisto_resolve_latest() {
    42	  local tag

   151	callisto_install_native() {

   200	      ;;
